WITH team_averages AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        SUM(w) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT year) AS avg_wins,
        AVG((g - l) * 1.0 / NULLIF(l, 0)) AS avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss
    FROM manager_half
    GROUP BY team_id
),
eligible AS (
    SELECT *,
           AVG(avg_wins) OVER () AS mean_team_avg_wins
    FROM team_averages
)
SELECT
    team_id,
    avg_wins,
    avg_games_minus_losses_per_loss,
    avg_wins - mean_team_avg_wins AS gap_above_mean
FROM eligible
WHERE avg_wins > mean_team_avg_wins
ORDER BY gap_above_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The mean is the unweighted mean of the per-team average wins across teams; each season is counted once per team, and rows with missing inputs or zero losses are ignored for the ratio average.
